format._note: Apertura 2026: top 8 of the general table straight to the quarter-finals (no play-in; press). Bracket and tie-breaks as in the official Reglamento de Competencia 2024-25 (Art. 19-21, read 2026-11-15): 1 v 8, 2 v 7, 3 v 6, 4 v 5; two legs, the better-placed club picks its home leg (the second); a quarter-final or semi-final level on aggregate goes to the better-placed club; semi-finalists re-ranked 1-4 (1 v 4, 2 v 3); the final level on aggregate plays two 15-minute extra periods, then penalties. Table chain in the Reglamento: goal difference, goals for, away goals for, head-to-head, cociente table, fair play, draw; the model stops after away goals. The 2026-27 PDF (ligamx.net/cancha/reglamentos) could not be downloaded from this container. Final dates are the press-reported plan.
